title: After two months of testimony, the US criminal trial against Huawei, accused of bank fraud and trade secret theft, is set to begin jury deliberations Wednesday (Karen Freifeld/Reuters)
summary: Karen Freifeld / Reuters: After two months of testimony, the US criminal trial against Huawei, accused of bank fraud and trade secret theft, is set to begin jury deliberations Wednesday — A defense lawyer for Huawei argued on Tuesday that US prosecutors had put a “sinister spin” on the Chinese technology company's …
